text: UT Dallas > Office of the Registrar > Registration Procedures Registration Procedures Registering for Classes. See the specific steps for undergraduate and graduate students registering for classes. Degree Planner. This Student Center tool is invaluable for planning which courses to take each semester. Office of the Registrar Schedule Planner. Input your desired classes and availability to generate a schedule that works for you. Wait List Instructions. Learn about the process for adding and removing your self from a course’s wait list.

text: Follow these details for submitting a request to drop a class. Check Enrollment Status. See details about the minimum course load required. Enrollment Verification. There are three convenient methods to obtain documents for verifying enrollment. Academic Advising. Contact your academic advising department, based on the school in which you are majoring. Auditing A Class. Auditing allows a student to observe the instruction of a course without earning credit. Special Programs. See policies for concurrent enrollment, undergrads taking graduate courses and more.
